card.name: Words before a made or sold device
card.fires_on: Small words and symbols right where a manufactured object is described, such as 'made of', 'designed and', 'manufactured by', or a price '$' for a product. The next word is expected to name equipment or hardware.

modes.label: Made of / designed and built
modes.description: Linking word after made, designed or manufactured, before a material or maker.
modes.example: Orbital Sciences Corporation of Dulles, Va., designed<< and>> built the Dawn spacecraft.

modes.description: Dollar sign before the price of a device or gadget.
modes.example: These radios are sold by many retail outlets and can cost less than<< $>>20 in their basic form.

modes.description: Word inside a description of containers or devices, such as a glass vial type.
